observations: Photo 0 is a digital promotional flyer, not a photograph of a physical item.
The flyer features stock images of a PlayStation 4 Pro console and a DualShock 4 controller.
Text in photo 0 includes 'GET YOUR FAVORITE GAMES ON YOUR PS4 GOLDHEN JAILBROKEN CONSOLE' and 'GAME DOWNLOAD SERVICE'.
The flyer displays covers for games: 'Grand Theft Auto V', 'FC 25', 'Modern Warfare III', 'Red Dead Redemption 2', 'God of War Ragnarok', and 'Spider-Man 2'.
The 'Spider-Man 2' cover in the flyer has a 'PS4' banner at the top, and it is listed under 'POPULAR GAMES'.
The seller's text offers a service to 'Download and install any game of your choice'.

claims.claim: Download and install any game of your choice
claims.evidence: Requires physical access to the console and verification of the game library.
Spider-Man 2 is a PS5-exclusive title and does not have an official PS4 release.
No physical console is shown to verify the software version or jailbreak status.

risks.risk: The listing is for a service, not a physical good.
risks.proof: A photo of a physical console for sale with a unique identifier (e.g., a handwritten note).
risks.if_unproven: as a service with no resale value

risks.risk: The offer includes technically impossible software (Spider-Man 2 on PS4).
risks.proof: A video showing the specific game running on a PS4 console.

response.reason: The listing uses a generic digital flyer instead of photos of a physical item. It advertises 'Spider-Man 2' for the PS4, which is a PS5-exclusive game, indicating a technical impossibility and a likely scam.
